limitations: The extended P2P case still fails its explicitly benign labels with six residual findings: five mixed peer groups and one DNS group.
This small reviewed corpus does not establish general malware recall, production precision, or a false-positive probability.
Session records and original packet examples are bounded; retained protocol counts describe scoring windows, not complete capture-wide dissections.
Outbound-only application sessions remain eligible; missing inbound data does not prove a successful exchange or benign traffic.
No capture bytes, original packet references, payloads, torrent info-hashes, peer IDs, or local capture paths are included in this summary.
